storyTitle: Perform Three-Way Match Invoice Verification For A Gmp Material Purchase

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The user can access the "Create Supplier Invoice" Fiori app.
acceptanceCriteria.failureImpact: User cannot initiate invoice verification process

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The system automatically proposes the quantity and value based on the referenced PO and goods receipt.
acceptanceCriteria.failureImpact: Incorrect invoice amounts proposed → payment errors → financial reconciliation issues

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The system blocks the invoice for payment if the invoiced quantity exceeds the received quantity beyond a configurable tolerance.
acceptanceCriteria.type: Functional — Business Rule Validation (Three-Way Match Logic)
acceptanceCriteria.failureImpact: Payment released for undelivered goods → financial loss

acceptanceCriteria.statement: The system blocks the invoice for payment if the invoiced price varies from the PO price beyond a configurable tolerance.
acceptanceCriteria.type: Functional — Business Rule Validation (Three-Way Match Logic)
acceptanceCriteria.failureImpact: Payment released at incorrect price → financial loss or overpayment

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Blocked invoices are routed to a resolution workflow visible in "Manage Blocked Invoices."
acceptanceCriteria.failureImpact: Blocked invoices not visible → no resolution → delayed payments → supplier disputes

acceptanceCriteria.statement: Once discrepancies are resolved, the invoice is automatically released for payment.
acceptanceCriteria.failureImpact: Invoice remains blocked after resolution → delayed payment → supplier relations impacted

scenarios.description: Create supplier invoice for GMP material PO with perfect three-way match (invoice qty = GR qty, invoice price = PO price) → invoice posted and released for payment
Create supplier invoice with quantity variance within tolerance → invoice posted and released (no block)
Create supplier invoice with price variance within tolerance → invoice posted and released (no block)
Create supplier invoice referencing PO with multiple GRs → system proposes cumulative open quantity
Create supplier invoice referencing PO with partial GR → system proposes only received quantity
Unauthorized user attempts to access "Create Supplier Invoice" app → access denied
User enters non-existent PO number → error message "PO not found"
User enters PO with no goods receipt → error message or zero quantity proposed
User enters PO already fully invoiced → error message "PO fully invoiced"
Create supplier invoice with quantity exceeding GR quantity beyond tolerance → invoice blocked, blocking reason "Quantity variance"
Create supplier invoice with price exceeding PO price beyond tolerance → invoice blocked, blocking reason "Price variance"
Create supplier invoice with both quantity and price variances beyond tolerance → invoice blocked with multiple blocking reasons
User posts invoice without required field (e.g., invoice date, posting date) → error message "Enter [field name]"
Create supplier invoice with quantity exactly at tolerance boundary (GR qty + tolerance) → invoice released (no block)
Create supplier invoice with quantity at tolerance + 0.01 → invoice blocked
Create supplier invoice with price exactly at tolerance boundary (PO price + tolerance) → invoice released (no block)
Create supplier invoice with price at tolerance + 0.01 → invoice blocked
Create supplier invoice with zero quantity → error message "Enter quantity"
Create supplier invoice with zero price → error message "Net price must be greater than 0"
Create supplier invoice with negative quantity → error message or system rejection
Create supplier invoice with negative price → error message or system rejection
Blocked invoice appears in "Manage Blocked Invoices" worklist with correct blocking reason and variance details
User corrects blocked invoice quantity to match GR → invoice auto-released and visible in payment run
User corrects blocked invoice price to match PO → invoice auto-released and visible in payment run
User manually releases blocked invoice (if authorized) → invoice status changes to "Released for Payment"
Payment run includes released invoice → payment document created for supplier

masterData.notes: Must have payment terms, bank details
Material type: ROH (Raw material) or HAWA (Trading goods)
Status: Released, GR posted, not fully invoiced
Must be posted to same PO line item

keyRisks.mitigation: Query T169Q and T169P tables before test case design; document actual tolerance values

keyRisks.risk: GR document not available for test PO
keyRisks.mitigation: Execute GR posting as part of test data setup; use CS-2 PO if GR already posted

keyRisks.risk: Blocking not triggered due to misconfigured tolerance
keyRisks.mitigation: Verify tolerance settings in pre-test validation; use multiple test data variants to confirm blocking logic

keyRisks.risk: Blocked invoice worklist app not accessible
keyRisks.mitigation: Verify "Manage Blocked Invoices" app authorization and availability before AC-5 test execution

keyRisks.risk: Invoice cannot be corrected/released in Fiori
keyRisks.mitigation: Document alternate resolution paths (MRBR transaction, manual release via MIRO); test both Fiori and GUI workflows

integrationPoints.description: PO data lookup for quantity and price validation
GR quantity lookup for three-way match
Blocked invoices must be excluded; released invoices included
